import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int[][] residual;
    static int sinkNode;

    static boolean inBounds(int r, int c, int N) {
        return r >= 0 && r < N && c >= 0 && c < N;
    }

    static boolean dfsAugment(int u, int[] parent) {
        if (u == sinkNode) return true;
        for (int v = 0; v <= sinkNode; ++v) {
            if (residual[u][v] > 0 && parent[v] == -1) {
                parent[v] = u;
                if (dfsAugment(v, parent)) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int getAugment() {
        int[] parent = new int[sinkNode + 1];
        Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
        parent[0] = 0;
        if (!dfsAugment(0, parent)) return 0;
        int add = 10000;
        for (int v = sinkNode; v != 0; v = parent[v]) {
            add = Math.min(add, residual[parent[v]][v]);
        }
        for (int v = sinkNode; v != 0; v = parent[v]) {
            residual[parent[v]][v] -= add;
            residual[v][parent[v]] += add;
        }
        return add;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        char[][] g = new char[10][11];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                g[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        int[][][] gridPlant = new int[10][10][T + 1];
        int[][] sourceCap = new int[10][10];
        int[][] sinkCap = new int[10][10];

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (g[i][j] == 'Y' || g[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    gridPlant[i][j][0] = g[i][j] - 'X';
                    sourceCap[i][j] = 0;
                } else {
                    gridPlant[i][j][0] = 0;
                    sourceCap[i][j] = g[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                g[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (g[i][j] == 'Y' || g[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    gridPlant[i][j][0] = g[i][j] - 'X';
                    sinkCap[i][j] = 0;
                } else {
                    gridPlant[i][j][0] = 0;
                    sinkCap[i][j] = g[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        int[] dirR = {0, 0, -1, 1};
        int[] dirC = {-1, 1, 0, 0};

        for (int time = 1; time <= T; ++time) {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                    gridPlant[i][j][time] = gridPlant[i][j][time - 1];
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                    if (gridPlant[i][j][time - 1] == 2) {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int ni = i + dirR[d];
                            int nj = j + dirC[d];
                            if (inBounds(ni, nj, N) && gridPlant[ni][nj][time - 1] == 0) {
                                gridPlant[ni][nj][time] = 2;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int[][] sourceId = new int[10][10];
        int[][] sinkId = new int[10][10];
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(sourceId[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(sinkId[i], -1);
        }

        sinkNode = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (sourceCap[i][j] != 0) sourceId[i][j] = sinkNode++;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (sinkCap[i][j] != 0) sinkId[i][j] = sinkNode++;
            }
        }

        residual = new int[250][250];
        for (int i = 0; i < 250; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(residual[i], 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (sourceCap[i][j] == 0) continue;
                boolean[][] seen = new boolean[10][10];
                Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
                q.add(new int[]{0, i, j});
                seen[i][j] = true;
                int src = sourceId[i][j];
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] cur = q.poll();
                    int time = cur[0];
                    int r = cur[1];
                    int c = cur[2];
                    if (sinkCap[r][c] != 0) {
                        residual[src][sinkId[r][c]] = 10000;
                    }
                    if (time == T) continue;
                    if (gridPlant[r][c][time] != 0) continue;
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int nr = r + dirR[d];
                        int nc = c + dirC[d];
                        if (inBounds(nr, nc, N) && gridPlant[nr][nc][time] == 0 && !seen[nr][nc]) {
                            seen[nr][nc] = true;
                            q.add(new int[]{time + 1, nr, nc});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (sourceCap[i][j] != 0) residual[0][sourceId[i][j]] = sourceCap[i][j];
                if (sinkCap[i][j] != 0) residual[sinkId[i][j]][sinkNode] = sinkCap[i][j];
            }
        }

        int total = 0;
        int flow;
        while ((flow = getAugment()) != 0) {
            total += flow;
        }
        System.out.println(total);
        sc.close();
    }
}
